units.source_text: 多年後，在電車上，很多次都覺得一些人的面孔似曾相識，

en.t: Years later, on the train, I often felt that certain faces looked familiar,

units.source_text: 想來想去，最後才想起原來與那家壽司攤鋪的老闆很像，不禁苦笑再三。

en.t: after thinking it over, I would finally realize that they looked very much like the owner of that sushi stall, and I could not help smiling bitterly again and again.

units.source_text: 那個女人的名字和麵孔即使現在淡出了我的記憶，

en.t: Even now, although that woman's name and face have faded from my memory,

units.source_text: 卻唯獨鮮明地記著那家壽司攤鋪老闆的面孔，甚至能正確地描摹出他的畫像，

en.t: I alone remember the face of that sushi-stall owner vividly, so vividly that I could even draw his portrait accurately,

units.source_text: 可見當時的壽司有多麼難吃，是帶給我寒冷和痛苦的記憶所致。

en.t: which must show how bad the sushi was then, and how the memory had brought me cold and pain.

units.source_text: 話雖如此，就算有人帶我去好吃的壽司店，

en.t: Even so, even when someone took me to a sushi restaurant said to be good,
I never once thought it tasted good.
Sushi is simply much too large,

units.source_text: 我總在想，難道就不能捏成像大拇指一樣大小嗎）。

en.t: and I was always wondering whether they could not make it about the size of a thumb.)

units.source_text: 她在本所的木匠家二樓租住了一個房間。

en.t: She had rented a room on the second floor of a carpenter's house in Honjo.
